description: High-speed BT30 drill/tap machining center, typified by the FANUC ROBODRILL alpha-DiB series. Deliberately a separate pack from the 40-taper VMC rather than a variant of it, because the maintenance is genuinely different: there is no centralized way-oil system to check the flow of. The axes run on grease, applied on a fixed operating-hour schedule, and the failure you are guarding against is a grease interval that was missed rather than a lube line that blocked. The turret-style tool changer is fast (about 1.6 s cut-to-cut) and is the other thing that wears.

ebs.name: Spindle assembly
ebs.functionalDescription: BT30 high-speed spindle. Small taper, high rpm, low tolerance for contamination in the taper.

children.name: Spindle-end gear
children.functionalDescription: Greased every 200 operating hours per the maintenance manual.

children.name: Drawbar / clamping unit
children.nameEs: Barra de tiro / unidad de amarre

children.name: Z axis brake
children.functionalDescription: Holds the head on power loss. A failure here drops the spindle.

ebs.name: Turret tool changer
ebs.functionalDescription: 21-pocket turret. Fast, and the second thing on this machine that wears. Its gear is greased every 200 operating hours.

ebs.name: Grease lubrication points
ebs.functionalDescription: Not a circulating oil system. Grease units are refilled on an operating-hour schedule; there is no pressure alarm to warn you, so the schedule IS the protection.

specKeys.labelEs: Unidad de grasa de husillos de bolas

pmTemplates.title: Daily operator check
tasks: Coolant level and concentration (refractometer, not by eye)
Air pressure at the regulator and drain the water separator
Clear chips from the pan and around the turret
Wipe the spindle taper and check for nicks or coolant residue
Visual: leaks, damaged covers, loose fittings
Listen: abnormal spindle or turret noise during a tool change
tasksEs: Nivel y concentracion de refrigerante (refractometro, no a ojo)
Presion de aire y purgar el separador de agua
Retirar virutas de la bandeja y alrededor de la torreta
Limpiar el cono del husillo y revisar golpes o residuos
Visual: fugas, cubiertas danadas, racores flojos
Escuchar: ruido anormal del husillo o la torreta al cambiar herramienta

pmTemplates.title: 200-hour greasing - spindle and turret gears
pmTemplates.titleEs: Engrase de 200 horas - engranajes de husillo y torreta
pmTemplates.description: Per the RoboDrill maintenance manual: grease the gear at the end of the spindle and the turret gear every 200 operating hours. There is no low-pressure alarm on a grease system, so this schedule is the only thing protecting these components.
tasks: Grease the gear at the end of the spindle
Grease the turret gear
Check the turret indexes smoothly through all 21 pockets
Record the actual spindle-hour reading against this service
tasksEs: Engrasar el engranaje del extremo del husillo
Engrasar el engranaje de la torreta
Comprobar que la torreta indexa suavemente en las 21 posiciones
Registrar la lectura real de horas de husillo de este servicio

pmTemplates.title: 1000-hour greasing - LM guides and ballscrews
pmTemplates.titleEs: Engrase de 1000 horas - guias LM y husillos de bolas
pmTemplates.description: Per the maintenance manual: grease the LM guide blocks and the ball screws every 1000 operating hours. Missing this is how ballscrews on these machines die early.
tasks: Refill/replace the guide rail grease unit (A90L-0001-0534#LHLX1007, 700 cm3)
Refill/replace the ballscrew grease unit (A90L-0001-0534#LHLX1004, 400 cm3)
Check each axis by hand for binding or roughness before and after
Record axis load meter readings for the same reference program - a gradual rise is wear
Inspect the way wipers for damage letting chips past
tasksEs: Rellenar/reemplazar la unidad de grasa de guias (A90L-0001-0534#LHLX1007, 700 cm3)
Rellenar/reemplazar la unidad de grasa de husillos (A90L-0001-0534#LHLX1004, 400 cm3)
Comprobar cada eje a mano buscando agarrotamiento o aspereza
Registrar la carga de los ejes con el mismo programa de referencia
Inspeccionar los limpiadores de guias

pmTemplates.title: Annual precision & safety
tasks: Ballbar test - record the result, it is the trend that matters
Spindle runout at the taper and thermal growth check
Backlash measurement on each axis
Verify the Z-axis brake holds the head with power removed
Door interlock and E-stop verification
Electrical cabinet clean and filter replacement
Coolant system full drain, clean and recharge
tasksEs: Prueba de barra de bolas - registrar el resultado
Excentricidad del husillo y crecimiento termico
Medicion de juego en cada eje
Verificar que el freno del eje Z sostiene el cabezal sin alimentacion
Verificacion de enclavamiento de puertas y parada de emergencia
Limpieza del armario electrico y cambio de filtro
Vaciado, limpieza y recarga del sistema de refrigerante

failureModes.typicalMechanism: Fatigue spalling or lubrication breakdown at high rpm
failureModes.typicalCauses: Sustained operation near max rpm beyond duty cycle; coolant ingress past the seal; crash overload; missed 200-hour greasing
failureModes.detectionMethods: Spindle load meter rising for the same program; temperature; audible change; degrading surface finish

failureModes.nameEn: Spindle taper damage / poor tool seating
failureModes.nameEs: Dano en el cono del husillo / mal asiento de herramienta
failureModes.typicalMechanism: Fretting and impact damage in a BT30 taper
failureModes.typicalCauses: Chips in the taper at tool change; dropped tool; over-torqued or damaged pull studs
failureModes.detectionMethods: Runout check with an indicator; visible marking in the taper; chatter that moves with the tool

failureModes.nameEs: Fallo de indexado de la torreta / herramienta caida
failureModes.typicalMechanism: Gear and cam wear, or grip force loss
failureModes.typicalCauses: Missed 200-hour turret greasing; low air pressure; chips in the turret; worn grippers
failureModes.detectionMethods: Alarm during tool change; audible knock; visible hesitation while indexing

failureModes.nameEs: Desgaste del husillo de bolas / juego
failureModes.typicalMechanism: Ball and raceway wear from inadequate grease
failureModes.typicalCauses: Missed 1000-hour greasing; contamination past damaged wipers; crash
failureModes.detectionMethods: Indicator reversal test; ballbar circularity; rising axis load meter

failureModes.typicalMechanism: Commanded position and actual position diverge beyond the parameter limit
failureModes.typicalCauses: Mechanical binding in the guides or ballscrew; way cover dragging; failing servo motor or amplifier; supply voltage sag
failureModes.detectionMethods: Control alarm SV0410 (stopped) or SV0411 (moving); check the axis by hand for binding

failureModes.nameEs: Fallo del freno del eje Z
failureModes.detectionMethods: Head drifts down with power removed - test this deliberately at the annual service

failureModes.nameEs: Concentracion de refrigerante fuera de especificacion
failureModes.typicalCauses: Water top-up without concentrate; evaporation; tramp oil
Blocked cooling airflow; clogged filter; sustained heavy cutting beyond duty cycle; failing bearings
failureModes.detectionMethods: Control alarm; spindle temperature; recurrence at normal load means bearings
